meta.name: ask-matt
meta.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据你的需求推荐合适的技能或流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你面对多个技能不知如何选择
copy.tagline_en: Recommend the right skill or flow for your situation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have many skills and need help choosing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个技能导航员。当你不知道用什么技能或流程时，它会根据你的描述推荐最合适的技能或路径，并解释如何进入主流程。
howto.when: 当你对当前任务不确定该用哪个技能，或者想了解整个技能库的流程时，可以主动询问。

say.text: 我想做一个新功能，但不知道从哪开始。
我有一堆 bug 报告，该怎么处理？
say.note: Claude 会推荐 /triage 技能来处理。

say.text: 这个项目太大了，一个会话做不完。
say.note: Claude 会建议使用 /wayfinder 来规划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a skill navigator. When you don't know which skill or flow to use, it recommends the most suitable one based on your description and explains how to enter the main flow.
howto.when_en: When you are unsure which skill to use for your current task, or want to understand the overall skill library flow, you can ask.

say_en.text: I want to build a new feature, but don't know where to start.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you into the main flow starting with /grill-with-docs.

say_en.text: I have a pile of bug reports, how should I handle them?
This project is too big for one session.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using /wayfinder to plan.
